temporal_scope: Two exact January/July15,2022snapshots,not seasonal means/annual extrema.
method: Finite paired component contours and unique linear strips on consecutive native longitude columns;minimum native-supported span where boundaries are censored. Original pre-tag fixed-latitude sections and3km tolerance preserved.
surface_gate_interpretation: Original per-owner surface gates are weaker than primary layer cutoffs;they do not force the selected primary layer to surface. Source graph surface connectivity is topology only,not physical current geometry.
minimum_span_interpretation: Conditional first-to-last contiguous native support under original piecewise-linear signed-component model,not physical current thickness bounds. Single-level zero is uninformative,not absence.
range_interpretation: Native-bracket sampling scenarios,not physical uncertainty,confidence intervals or annual envelopes.
identity_scope: California offshore southward branch excludes poleward undercurrent/Davidson/coastal flow. Alaska is offshore eastern-Gulf northward reach,not Alaska Coastal Current,westward Alaskan Stream or whole gyre. Southern East Madagascar is the restricted southward eastern branch,not northern branch/intermediate undercurrent/retroflection/Mozambique/Agulhas. No inherited depth or independently classified current body.

interpretation: Partial regional component geometry,not independently identified named-current axis,flow-normal width,whole-route depth,terrain clearance or physical volume. No between-section interpolation or additive water bodies.
